sourceCommit: 35018c4a3 plus uncommitted bench/drop-in/dropin_phase_harness.c and bench/tools/dropin_phase_cohort.py (hashes below)
surface: dropin (public webgpu.h ABI); one harness source linked per provider
workloadOrigin: Node5 package workloads: unchanged WGSL, generator, seed 0 inputs; set 1 = same generator seed+1000; independent CPU oracle cross-checked against frozen Node5 capture oracles

providers.dawn-aa: byte-identical copy of the dawn harness binary (A/A control)

excludedProviders.doe-zig: retained Zig libwebgpu_doe_full.so rejects the TimedWaitAny instance feature at wgpuCreateInstance; fail-closed, recorded unsupported for this harness, not timed

sampling.orders: all 6 permutations of the 3 providers, cycled

phases.oracle: every iteration, after the operation interval closes; any mismatch fails the process

statistics.paired: per-pair ratio provider/dawn of per-process metrics
statistics.summary: median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029), provider-faster pair count, per-provider medians and p95

validity: every process status ok with all iterations oracle-checked
all providers report Radeon 8060S on Vulkan, adapterType != CPU
A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median ratio within [0.95,1.05] and its CI95 contains 1
acceptance.scopedWarmOperationWin: doe-c/dawn warm.operation ratio CI95 upper < 1.0 AND warmP95.operation ratio CI95 upper < 1.0 AND cpuMs ratio median <= 1.05 AND maxRssMiB ratio median <= 1.10
acceptance.oneTimeRegressionBound: setupNs+compileNs+pipelineNs individually: ratio CI95 lower bound <= 1.10, else recorded regression
acceptance.claimBoundary: A pass is a scoped native drop-in phase result on these three Node5 workloads on this host only. It is not the GOALS Vulkan application win, which needs a complete unchanged application.

hostControls: flock models-volume/doe-gpu-timing.lock; four Reploid participant units stopped for the window and restarted by EXIT trap; renderD128 holders recorded before timing
